title: Signal Conversion
text: Convert signal to new type without altering signal values, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Output} sets Type of conversion Signal copy; {Data type} sets the nonvirtual bus data type Inherit and {Exclude this block from ’Block reduction’ optimization} sets the option to exclude block from block reduction. Values come from the instance.
